items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1966-01-20
items.q: Minor tried to make it. I don't worry about them.

ctx.x: Yeah, well I never have heard anybody else ever do that. They ain't going to never do it. No, I mean I've heard them try to copy and all that. That's right. They can't cut.

They tried to copy. I don't know. I went down to Jaffer's couple times and he asked me to play it. I play it and he get his horn and play along with me and I just take down. I say good lick. It's all right. She makes the hoop. They don't make it. Brown tried to make it. Minor tried to make it. I don't worry about them. I make it. Make it when I get ready and put anything in it I want. It's like Larry come there one night. Larry said, I never heard a man make a triple turn on the best way to do. And he brought…
When you were coming up then you didn't listen to anybody much? Oh yeah.
